title: Now comes the test for Dems: household budget relief
summary: Democrats won the midterms on voter frustration with high prices . Why it matters: Prices for necessities like groceries and gas can fall in a healthy economy. But the kind of broad price declines that would reverse years of price gains would likely come with job losses and falling incomes, leaving households worse off than before.
